messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete, playable first-person 3D tower RPG with 100 floors, progression, combat, loot, bosses, NPCs, customization, language settings, and substantial playtime.

## Requirements
- User requested a nameable/customizable character, distributable stats, difficulty choices, rarity-based armor/weapons/relics, powers, bosses, AI NPCs, interface sounds, and language switching.
- Do not ask clarification; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them at completion.

## Decisions
- Implemented as a standalone `index.html` using a custom Canvas raycasting engine rather than external 3D/game dependencies.
- Added English/Spanish language options, three character paths, and Story/Standard/Nightmare difficulty.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created a playable game prototype in `index.html` with first-person movement, raycast environments, enemies, combat, spells, loot, rarity/equipment, NPC dialogue/trading, stat points, boss floors, stairs, settings, sound effects, touch controls, and local autosaves.
- JavaScript syntax check passed; `curl` returned HTTP 200 for `http://localhost:3002/index.html`.

### Active
- Review and improve/fix gameplay and interface behavior; verify the game in a browser if possible.

### Blocked
- `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` could not run because Chromium was not installed at the expected Playwright path (`Browser "chromium" is not installed`). System Chromium exists at `/usr/bin/chromium`.

## Next Move
1. Inspect `index.html` for runtime/gameplay defects, especially language switching and save/continue behavior.
2. Run browser-based checks using system Chromium or install the Playwright Chromium browser; address any console errors.
3. Summarize the implemented assumptions and validation when finished.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Entire game implementation, styling, and JavaScript.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- A local HTTP server was started on port 3002.
- Last browser check used `chromium --headless --no-sandbox --disable-gpu --virtual-time-budget=1000 --dump-dom http://localhost:3002`; DOM loaded, but no gameplay interaction was tested.
